For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense…
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,
“As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that…

For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.
translations.bsb: “Believe Me, woman,” Jesus replied, “a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.
translations.asv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, shall ye worship the Father.
